guide.title: Uther's Overview
guide.text:
Uther is a Healer whose strongest points are
his single-target burst healing
and reliable crowd control,
but his Mana costs are prohibitive for extended team fights
and the inability to keep multiple allied Heroes healthy.

guide.title: Uther's Strengths and Weaknesses
guide.text:
Strengths
Strong burst healing
When healing allied Heroes, provides Armor to them
Reliable crowd control
High healing output right after dying (see Devotion)
Weaknesses
Poor sustain healing and low Mana efficiency
Weak waveclear
Lack of mobility

guide.title: Uther's Synergies and Counters
guide.text:
Uther synergizes with
Uther's high instantaneous healing and reliable means of providing Armor make
him particularly potent with aggressive melee Heroes that can provide their own
self-sustain but may otherwise need help against burst damage.
You can get even more value from Armor by pairing Uther with
a sustain Healer (such as Malfurion).
Divine Shield enables some of the game's most dangerous combos by allowing
certain Heroes to play aggressively without fear of retaliation (for example Kerrigan).
Similarly, it can be used to protect channeled Abilities
(notably Mosh Pit by E.T.C.) from enemy interrupts.
Uther is countered by
Although not particularly vulnerable to any specific Hero himself, Uther
tends to struggle against sustain damage, particularly over an area of
effect, as his healing is powerful, but ultimately inefficient. His sub-par waveclear
can also be problematic if your team composition does not make up for this
weakness somewhere else.

guide.title: Uther's Maps
guide.text:
Uther's stronger maps
Uther's average maps
Uther's weaker maps
Thanks to his burst healing, Uther prefers Maps where
it is possible to secure the Objective after winning a quick team fight
(such as Infernal Shrines) and that always get
to the late game when he can shine more.
Due to his poor Mana efficiency and lack of area of effect healing,
Uther does not perform well on Maps that involve long battles
that expose his team to poke damage, especially during
the early game (such as Braxis Holdout).

guide.title: Uther's Tips and Tricks
guide.text:
Having high cooldown and Mana cost, Holy Light should preferably be used to save allied Heroes currently being focused down.
Considering it pierces, Holy Radiance gives more value when used to hit multiple allied and/or enemy Heroes at the same time.
Use Hammer of Justice on high-priority targets to help your team kill them and/or on dangerous enemy Heroes to peel for your team.
Although being a powerful saving tool, Divine Shield truly shines when used to enable an allied Hero with high damage output to play aggressively.
Divine Storm, in conjuction with Hammer of Justice, can be used to lock an enemy Hero in place for almost 3 seconds.
Ideally, once all your Abilities are on cooldown, you should position as aggressively as possible and hope to be killed in order to heal your teammates with Devotion.
See our Abilities page for further information »

guide.title: Uther's Role in the Current Meta
guide.text:
Uther is a Healer that can give Armor
to any allied Hero and save them from huge amounts of burst damage.
Besides helping the team with healing and defensive tools,
Uther provides a considerable amount of crowd control
that can be used to engage, follow up,
or peel.
Considering that his power comes at the cost of high Mana consumption,
avoid drafting Uther as solo Healer when you expect prolonged team fights,
when sustain healing is important to keep your team alive,
else you will not be able to handle the enemy poke and sustain damage.
In addition to being played as solo Healer,
Uther can also be played alongside another Healer
to make up for his lack of sustain healing and huge Mana consumption. In those cases,
he will be played as Support, in the Flex slot of the draft composition
(meaning that you will have only one Ranged Assassin).
Although he used to be occasionally played as Tank in the past,
the fact Uther now gets 15 rather than 25 Armor from Devotion
means he is way easier to take down. In coordinated play you may see him being deployed
as an enabler for unconventional Tank replacements (for example
Kerrigan or Maiev), but no longer as main Tank.
Last but not the least, we do not recommend playing Uther as
Offlaner because he lacks waveclear
and he struggles to defend Mercenary Camps as well. Doing this would be a huge weakness
for your team composition, even on 2-lane Maps.

abilities.title: Uther's Tips and Tricks
abilities.text:
Having high cooldown and Mana cost, Holy Light should preferably be used to save allied Heroes currently being focused down.
Considering it pierces, Holy Radiance gives more value when used to hit multiple allied and/or enemy Heroes at the same time.
Use Hammer of Justice on high-priority targets to help your team kill them and/or on dangerous enemy Heroes to peel for your team.
Although being a powerful saving tool, Divine Shield truly shines when used to enable an allied Hero with high damage output to play aggressively.
Divine Storm, in conjuction with Hammer of Justice, can be used to lock an enemy Hero in place for almost 3 seconds.
Ideally, once all your Abilities are on cooldown, you should position as aggressively as possible and hope to be killed in order to heal your teammates with Devotion.

abilities.title: Holy Light
abilities.text:
Holy Light
(Q)
Uther
Mana: 80
Cooldown: 12 seconds
Heal target allied Hero for 362 (+4% per level) Health. When used on a target other than Uther, also heal Uther for 181 (+4% per level) Health.
Holy Light is one of the strongest instant single-target healing Ability in
the game. Holy Light's raw power is compensated by its long cooldown and heavy
Mana cost, meaning that special care must be taken when choosing a target for
it; this Ability is in fact why Uther is generally considered to be
Mana-inefficient when compared to other Healers.
Still, Holy Light's value does not lie in its mediocre healing per cooldown, but in
its instantaneousness and raw healing amount; you must use this to your
advantage by prioritizing allies that are under immediate threat of dying. An
important aspect of properly using Holy Light is to avoid overhealing;
Holy Radiance should instead be used to top off your
allies' Health, when needed.

abilities.title: Holy Radiance
abilities.text:
Holy Radiance
(W)
Uther
Mana: 55
Cooldown: 10 seconds
Heal all allied Heroes and Minions in a line for 194 (+4% per level) Health, dealing 177 (+4% per level) damage to enemies.
Holy Radiance's power stems from its area of effect. Though it requires your
allies to be positioned in a line for best results, the Ability becomes
extremely efficient if you can manage to heal more than two targets with it.
The damage Holy Radiance inflicts, although unimpressive, is a small bonus that
can also reveal Bushes and Stealthed Heroes.
It is interesting to note that Holy Radiance also heals allied Minions, making it a
good Ability to use on-cooldown while laning, aiming for entire Minion waves
and opposing Heroes, if possible, for some poke damage.
Holy Radiance is the best way of applying Devotion's
Armor effect to multiple allied Heroes at once, which is
an excellent way of mitigating much incoming team fight damage.
Since Holy Radiance has a short traveling time, it essentially acts as a
skillshot that requires you to align with as many
Heroes — allied and enemy — as possible, for maximum effect.
Healing should be your primary concern unless the damage can earn you a killing
blow that your team would otherwise not be able to secure.

abilities.title: Hammer of Justice
abilities.text:
Hammer of Justice
(E)
Uther
Mana: 40
Cooldown: 10 seconds
Deal 109 (+4% per level) damage and Stun the target for 1 second.
Hammer of Justice's strength lies in its reliability: it is a targeted
Ability, meaning that it can never miss, unlike
skillshots. Its stunning component is useful to
initiate, peel, follow up, and
interrupt channeled
abilities.
It generally makes Assassins afraid of being within melee range
of Uther as well, which is a valuable attribute for an otherwise relatively
vulnerable Healer. Due to its relatively long cooldown and mediocre
damage, Hammer of Justice should exclusively be used when its stunning effect
will be useful.

abilities.title: Divine Shield
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Divine Shield
(R)
Uther
Heroic
Mana: 80
Cooldown: 90 seconds
Make an allied Hero Invulnerable and increase their Movement Speed by 20% for 3 seconds.
Divine Shield's unique effect allows you to force any focus away from your
selected target. It is versatile in that you can use it to prevent incoming
damage while your healing Abilities are coming off cooldown, ensure the escape
of a teammate, or simply make your chosen damage dealer
Unstoppable and completely free to deal their
damage.
Aggressively using Divine Shield to enable allied Heroes requires
a high level of communication to pull off, though it can be especially
effective. Favorite targets for such a strategy include deadly but otherwise
vulnerable melee Heroes (such as Kerrigan).
You can also use the Movement Speed and Invulnerable effect provided by
Divine Shield to save allied Heroes from danger
(for example right after they exit from Gorge by Stitches).
Additionally, the effect can be used to make channeled Abilities
(such as Mosh Pit by E.T.C.) completely
uninterruptible.

abilities.title: Divine Storm
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Divine Storm
(R)
Uther
Heroic
Mana: 80
Cooldown: 80 seconds
Deal 170 (+4% per level) damage and Stun nearby enemies for 1.75 seconds.
Divine Storm is a powerful crowd control effect
that will make enemy Heroes hit unable to act for almost 2 seconds,
allowing your teammates to follow-up
or protecting them and yourself from danger.
The fact that Divine Storm can hit multiple Heroes
creates a safe area around Uther as enemy Heroes will likely try to stay away from it.
Experienced opponents will be aware of this and move back when you move forward.
Although it would be great to Stun multiple Heroes at the same time,
you should not heistate to cast Divine Storm against a single enemy Hero,
be it as a form of engage or peeling.
When Hammer of Justice is on cooldown,
you can also use Divine Storm to interrupt
powerful channeled Abilities.

abilities.title: Devotion
abilities.text:
Devotion
(D)
Uther
Passive
Uther's Basic Abilities grant 25 Armor to allied Heroes, and 15 to Uther, for 2 seconds.
Eternal Vanguard
Upon dying, Uther becomes an Invulnerable spirit for up to 8 seconds. While in spirit form, Uther can heal allies with Flash of Light for 230 (+4% per level).
Devotion essentially turns Uther
into an unstoppable healing machine, as Flash of Light's
single-target healing per second potential is second to none. The fact that
Flash of Light is free to cast
and has an extremely low cooldown makes killing Uther a risky move
when he has already used all his Abilities.
Flash of Light has a cooldown of 1.5 seconds, which means that it
can be used up to 6 times during Devotion.
Heroes healed this way will still get Armor from your Trait.
Devotion's passive component defines Uther as the premiere
Healer to counter burst damage:
25 Armor
for allied Heroes affected by Holy Light,
Holy Radiance, or Flash of Light;
15 Armor for Uther when casting Holy Light
or Holy Radiance.
In terms of gameplay, to get more value from Devotion,
you should try to heal targets that are currently being
focused down, which should come rather intuitively.
In coordinated play you may see this powerful Trait used at Uther's advantage.
When the enemy team is already committed to a team fight, after using all his Abilities,
Uther can then play as aggressive as possible and hope to die before any other teammates.
At that point the rest of the team should not retreat, but keep fighting
for around 8 seconds to get Devotion value.

Holy Shock is a good Talent that, by giving you a separate

Holy Shock and Holy Light share their

The extra damage provided by this Talent can be useful when

Combine it with Silver Touch at Level 1

An added benefit of this Talent is that it can trigger

Mana cost and, thanks to the cooldown reduction,

The downside of the Talent, however, is that it does nothing
when using Holy Light to heal someone.

Holy Fire is a decent Talent that
somewhat improves Uther's abysmal waveclear
and increases his damage to enemy Heroes when having space to Basic Attack them.
One interesting aspect of the Talent is its ability to reveal Stealthed
Heroes, turning them into valid targets for Hammer of Justice
without the need of casting Holy Radiance towards them.
Similarly, it can be used to destroy hidden Summons on the ground
(like Creep Tumor by Zagara).

talent_pages.title: Level 7 Talents for Uther
talent_pages.text:
?
Armor of Faith
(Level 7)
Uther
Being Stunned, Rooted, or Silenced grants Uther 90 Mana and causes Holy Light's cooldown to recharge 200% faster for 6 seconds. This effect has a 20 second cooldown.
Armor of Faith is a situational Talent that punishes
opponents for Stunning Uther
himself by drastically reducing the cooldown of Holy Light.
Unlike the alternative options available on this Tier,
Armor of Faith cannot be used to help allied Heroes
affected by enemy crowd control,
reducing Uther's general utility but increasing his survivability.
?
Guardian of Ancient Kings
(Level 7)
Uther
Healing a Hero with a Basic Ability that is Stunned, Rooted, or Silenced grants them 50 Armor for 3 seconds.
Guardian of Ancient Kings is a situational Talent that grants allied Heroes a
very significant amount of Armor if you manage to heal them
with Holy Light or Holy Radiance
when they are affected by enemy crowd control.
Remember that it only works with Stun, Root,
and Silence.
✔
Hand of Protection
(Level 7)
Uther
Cooldown: 90 seconds
Activate to make target ally Unstoppable for 1 second. Cannot be cast on Uther. Basic Attacks reduce Hand of Protection's cooldown by 5 seconds.
Hand of Protection is a strong Talent that can be used
to make any allied Hero other than Uther himself Unstoppable
for 1 second, freeing them from any crowd control effect
and allowing them to channel any Ability
without risking to be interrupted.
While it has 30 seconds more cooldown than most cleanse effects
(such as Intercession by Whitemane),
you can reduce it by 30 seconds by using Basic Attacks for 6 seconds.

talent_pages.title: Level 10 Talents for Uther
talent_pages.text:
In this section we discuss when and why to pick a given Heroic Ability.
If you want to read how they work in detail and/or you are looking for some tips on how to use them,
check them out on the Abilities and Strategy page.
✔
Divine Shield
(Level 10)
Uther
Mana: 80
Cooldown: 90 seconds
Make an allied Hero Invulnerable and increase their Movement Speed by 20% for 3 seconds.
Divine Shield is a strong but relatively-hard-to-use Heroic Ability that provides
Movement Speed to an allied Hero and also make them Invulnerable
for a few seconds, a buff that will basically make them
Protected and Unstoppable
at the same time.
Pick it when you want to help an allied Hero to make an aggressive play
without the risk of being stopped and/or when you need a tool to save allied Heroes
from certain death.
?
Divine Storm
(Level 10)
Uther
Mana: 80
Cooldown: 80 seconds
Deal 170 (+4% per level) damage and Stun nearby enemies for 1.75 seconds.
Divine Storm is a good and relatively-easy-to-use Heroic Ability that allows
you to Stun for almost 2 seconds all enemies in a small area around you.
Do not hesitate to use it on isolated enemy Heroes!
Choose it when you need to counter-engage and/or peel
for your team, regardless of the Role you are covering in your team composition.

talent_pages.title: Level 13 Talents for Uther
talent_pages.text:
?
Blessed Champion
(Level 13)
Uther
For the next 5 seconds after using Holy Light, Uther's Basic Attacks heal him and nearby allied Heroes for 15% of the total amount healed by Holy Light.
Blessed Champion has the potential of providing some
incredible area of effect healing. This potential, however, hinges upon being
able to reliably deliver Basic Attacks, which may be not always possible.
The healing done by this Talent is also increased by the self-healing provided
by Beacon of Light at Level 16, so they are great
when paired together as they can increase Uther's sustain
healing by a considerable amount when the situation permits.
Pick this Talent when your team needs sustain healing,
when the enemy team lacks burst damage to quickly get a kill,
and/or when you want to keep your team healthy between team fights.
✔
Well Met
(Level 13)
Uther
When used against Heroes, Hammer of Justice reduces the target's Movement Speed and damage dealt by 25% for 3 seconds.
Well Met provides a modest but reliable debuff that stacks with the
Armor provided by Devotion in
terms of damage reduction. The Slow is also useful as well
when used with Hammer of the Lightbringer and
Pursuit of Justice as they allow you to consistently
maintain the debuff on your chosen target.
✘
Spell Shield
(Level 13)
Uther
Every 30 seconds, gain 50 Spell Armor against the next enemy Ability and subsequent Abilities for 3 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 50%.
Can be toggled to allow or prevent this talent from triggering automatically.
Spell Shield is a situational Talent that provides
Spell Armor for a few seconds when you take damage.
You can toggle it on or off.
If you do not want to waste its cooldown
when being hit by cheap damage, keep it off and only toggle it on
when you expect to take burst damage.
Since you cannot do this while under crowd control effects,
you should also toggle it on right before becoming unable to act because of them
because you will likely be hit by burst damage in that time window.
We find this Talent rarely needed because, after using his long-cooldown Basic Abilities
and especially his powerful Heroic Ability, Uther wants to be the first Hero to die
in team fights, so that he can get value from Devotion.

talent_pages.title: Level 16 Talents for Uther
talent_pages.text:
?
Beacon of Light
(Level 16)
Uther
Uther receives 125% bonus self-healing when targeting others with Holy Light. This bonus is increased to 250% while he is below 50% Health.
Beacon of Light provides half value when Uther has
high Health and full value when he is low on Health. When high Health,
Uther is healed by 226. When low Health, Uther is healed by twice that amount.
This effect drastically increases his survivability in prolonged team fights.
The self-healing provided by this Talent also increases the healing done
by Blessed Champion at Level 13, so they are great
when paired together as they can increase Uther's sustain
healing by a considerable amount when the situation permits.
?
Tyr's Deliverance
(Level 16)
Uther
Increase the damage and healing of Holy Radiance by 10%. Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes cause Uther's next cast of Holy Radiance to have its damage and healing increased by an additional 10%, stacking up to 7 times.
Tyr's Deliverance increases the damage and healing
coming from Holy Radiance by 10% as flat value
and by additional 10% for each Basic Attack done on enemy Heroes before casting it,
stacking up to additional 70% healing when allowed to freely use Basic Attack.
We do not recommended this Talent as we find it too hard to get value from
during most if not all games, especially if you consider that Benediction
and Beacon of Light will give you similar value in short
and long team fights respectively.
✔
Benediction
(Level 16)
Uther
Cooldown: seconds
Activate to reduce the Mana cost of Uther's next Basic Ability by 50 and its cooldown by 10 seconds.
Benediction is a strong Talent that can be activated
before using a Basic Ability to have its cooldown reset and its Mana cost
reduced by 50. Similarly to Rewind, it allows you
to cast the same Ability twice in a row.
Spend it on Holy Light when you need more
single-target healing, Holy Radiance when you
need more multi-target healing, or Hammer of Justice
when you need more crowd control.
If you have Pursuit of Justice at Level 4,
you can do a neat trick with this Talent: activate Benediction,
cast Hammer of Justice on any enemy unit nearby
(for example a Minion) to gain Movement Speed, run towards an enemy Hero,
and use Hammer of Justice on that Hero.

talent_pages.title: Level 20 Talents for Uther
talent_pages.text:
?
Bulwark of Light
(Level 20)
Uther
Divine Shield is also applied to all nearby allied Heroes and lasts 1 second longer.
Bulwark of Light is a situational Talent that can be used
for protecting several Heroes at once, something that is extremely strong
as a defensive tool when playing against team compositions
featuring a wombo combo.
?
Divine Hurricane
(Level 20)
Uther
Divine Storm's radius is increased by 50% and its cooldown is reduced by 40 seconds.
Divine Hurricane simply increases the reliability of
Divine Storm by allowing it to hit more targets. This
increases Uther's effective threat range, and can be particularly surprising to
unexpecting opponents. This Talent works well with combo-heavy teams that rely
on quickly wrestling kills to gain an advantage.
✔
Redemption
(Level 20)
Uther
After Eternal Vanguard ends, Uther revives at the spirit's location with 50% of his maximum Health.
This effect has a 180 second cooldown.
Redemption is one of the best Talents in the game.
The utility of being able to die, expending your opponent's time and resources,
to then be able to use Eternal Vanguard's outstanding healing
potential, to then revive near your team with a full Mana bar and a reasonable
amount of Health simply cannot be overstated.
Remember to move your spirit to a safe location before Eternal Vanguard ends because clever
opponents will quickly switch their attention to you if you happen to respawn near them.
This effect has a cooldown of 3 minutes, so avoid wasting it
and be careful not to die when it is not available.
?
Divine Protection
(Level 20)
Uther
Increase Devotion Armor to 50 and its duration by 0.5 seconds.
Divine Protection is a subtle yet extremely impactful
Talent that helps Uther with that which he is best at: mitigating burst damage.
Being able to gain and give 50 Amor on demand
and for a longer duration simply cannot be overstated,
especially when playing with another Healer in team.
